paragraphs: Rava bar Minyomi. His grandfather was R' Nahumi, in Rav Nahman's time: Yuhasin, under nun; see there.
Yuhasin writes in the name of ר״ח [provisionally Rabbenu Hananel]: there are twelve Ravas with an aleph and thirty-six with a heh, ‘and I found more.’ End quotation. I too have found more and more.
These are those mentioned by the name Rava; some are Rabbah. You will therefore find them there under Rabbah.
